title: Tickle Torture at the Hands of a Cult (ORIGINAL)
description: The road here is dark and unfamiliar... And your car that had been slowly stuttering past the clawing canopy of trees is now stuck at its wayside. You turn the key a few more times but realise it’s no use. Pulling out your phone only further dampens your hope. It's as if you shouldn't be here, wherever here is. No phone service. No map. No idea of where you are. You really are alone. Lost. Well the road has to lead to some place otherwise nobody would have built it. The path twists and turns, and as you wander you pull out your phone to try to light your way. The feeble light emitted feels like a drop of hope in a sea of infinite darkness. Until suddenly you see it. A village of sorts right there in the forest. It materialized so rapidly you have to blink a few times to make sure you are not seeing things. You look around and see scattered through the streets and among the simple houses, women gathering and whispering, peaking and looking over at you with hushed excitement. Are there no men here? It certainly seems this way, but you are too tired to question it, as you walk by the streets following the mysterious woman. Surely there are worse fates than spending the night in a town of beautiful women...
author: Mistress Shibby
